settings.heading:
Skin absorbs everything.
Treat it like biology.
settings.text: We sell literacy first, formulations second. Understand the mechanism, the concentration, and the Indian-skin context — then choose the right product.

settings.heading: Root cause over ritual
settings.text: Diagnose the biology first. Formulate second. A customer who understands their skin never buys the wrong product again.

settings.heading: Ingredient integrity
settings.text: Every active earns its place — backed by evidence, at efficacious concentrations, delivered with the right technology.

settings.heading: Climate-coded science
settings.text: Indian skin faces heat, humidity, UV, pollution and hard water. Formulas should match that volatility — not temperate-market defaults.

settings.heading: Clarity before another product.
settings.text: We built this layer so you can understand the concern, the mechanism, and the next step — without miracle timelines or ingredient theatre.

settings.heading: One country.
settings.description: Global formulas are built for Europe, the US, or Korea. Indian skin needs climate-responsive science — pick a city and see why context changes what your routine should prioritize.

settings.heading: Read the signal
settings.text: Establish a baseline from visible skin cues, concern history, and environmental context — before adding another active.

settings.heading: Name the mechanism
settings.text: Every recommendation should show what an ingredient does, at what concentration, and why it belongs in the routine.

settings.heading: Follow through
settings.text: Consistency creates usable signal. Track the routine so the next decision is better informed than the last.

settings.heading: Understand first. Formulate second.
settings.text: Education is part of the product. We make you understand before we make you buy — because the informed customer is the most loyal customer.

settings.heading: Mechanism, not marketing
settings.text: We explain what an ingredient is there to do — percentage plus pathway — not vague enrichment claims.

settings.heading: Efficacious concentrations
settings.text: Right ingredient + right technology. We don't decorate labels; we deliver doses that earn their place.

settings.heading: Barrier-first care
settings.text: Treat acne and oil without abandoning the lipid layer. Comfort and correction belong together.

settings.heading: Defensible claims only
settings.text: No miracle timelines. No glow hype. Evidence-backed language you can verify.

settings.heading: Evidence should be visible in the experience.
settings.text: Credibility is not a badge. It is how a formula is explained, a recommendation is reasoned, and progress is reviewed without unrealistic promises.
settings.cta_text: Understand your skin before adding another product.

settings.heading: Observe
settings.text: A guided image and concern check-in organize visible skin signals into a useful starting point.

settings.heading: Add context
settings.text: Climate, sensitivities, current products and routine history help explain what the image alone cannot.

settings.heading: Match
settings.text: Products are compared by concern, mechanism, formula role and potential routine conflicts.

settings.heading: Review
settings.text: Routine tracking and repeat check-ins create a clearer basis for continuing, changing or escalating care.

settings.heading: Four connected decisions
settings.text: Each layer adds context. Together they turn a one-time recommendation into a more useful skincare system.

settings.heading: A living profile of your skin context
settings.text: A guided scan organizes visible concerns alongside the context you provide. It creates a reusable cosmetic skincare baseline; it does not replace medical diagnosis.
settings.feature_1: Organizes visible acne, pigmentation, texture and barrier cues
settings.feature_2: Adds climate, routine and lifestyle context
settings.feature_3: Creates a consistent baseline for future check-ins

settings.heading: Recommendations with a reason
settings.text: Products are matched to the concern, active mechanism and routine role. Every recommendation should explain what it does and why it belongs.
settings.feature_3: Routine conflicts and unnecessary duplication reduced

settings.heading: A routine you can actually follow
settings.text: Track completed steps, keep product order clear, and build enough consistency to interpret a later skin check-in with better context.

settings.heading: Review what changed
settings.text: Regular check-ins compare the current state with the original baseline so the routine can be reviewed with better context.
settings.feature_2: Routine consistency viewed alongside skin signals
settings.feature_3: Escalation to dermatologist consultation when needed

settings.heading: From signal to smarter routine
settings.text: Project Skin connects analysis, product matching and daily adherence so recommendations can become more relevant over time.

settings.quote: Your moisturiser isn't failing you. Your barrier is compromised — and until the lipid layer is repaired, nothing you apply will absorb, retain, or function the way it should.

settings.heading: Guidance, not diagnosis
settings.text: Visible signals help organize cosmetic concerns; clinical symptoms need a dermatologist.

settings.heading: Consent and restraint
settings.text: Collect only what is needed for the experience and make the purpose of that information clear.

settings.heading: A route to human review
settings.text: When concerns fall outside cosmetic guidance, the next step is qualified clinical care.

settings.heading: Useful guidance. Clear limits.
settings.text: Project Skin technology is designed to improve cosmetic skincare decisions. It does not diagnose disease or replace qualified medical care.
